 CORAM:
HONOURABLE

MR. JUSTICE RUDRA PRAKASH  MISHRA  ORAL ORDER 13 15-03-2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2.
The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Chainpur P.S. Case No. 57 of 2015 instituted for the offences under Sections 420, 409 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. As per allegation, the petitioner being the Purchasing Manager deputed at a Paddy Purchasing Center (P.P.C.-1) Chainpur in 2012-13 did not supply grains costing to Rs. 4,52,72,439.42/- and thereby the petitioner Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.7834 of 2023(13) dt.15-03-2024 misappropriated the amount as alleged.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence as alleged against him and has falsely been implicated in the present case.

He further submits that the petitioner was posted as Block Agricultural Officer at Chainpur and at that time he was given additional charge of Block Agricultural Officer of Aadhaura and Bhabhua and the petitioner used to lookafter the said work of all the three blocks i.e. Chainpur, Adhaura and Shambhu Prasad Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199132106/
1 Bhabhua.

sentences.text: At that time, the petitioner was also given an additional work for becoming the In-charge of Procurement Centre, Chainpur and it was not possible for the petitioner to do the said work personally and two more persons were also deputed in the Procurement Centre namely Abhay Kumar Singh and Shashikant Kumar.
It has also been submitted that the Informant purposely did not mention the name of the aforesaid two persons i.e. Abhay Kumar Singh and Shashikant Kumar.
He again points out that the petitioner was only made Supervising Officer for Chainpur PPC-1 and only Dilip Kumar Gupta, Head Clerk was Patna High Court CR.
made Account Assistant and, thus, he cannot be said to be In-charge of the said Purchase Centre.
The petitioner superannuated from the service on 31 st of January, 2018.
Charge-sheet has been submitted in this case and the case is Magistrate triable.
The petitioner has one criminal antecedent as has been stated in paragraph no.3 of the present bail application.
The petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 18.08.2022.

5. Learned A.P.P. for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the petitioner stating that the petitioner, being the Manager of Purchasing Centre, the prime responsibility lies on him and he has misappropriated the huge amount of Government money and, thus, does not deserve bail.

6. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has filed counter and supplementary affidavit stating therein that the petitioner has committed heinous crime as he had deprived below poverty line beneficiaries of public food grain and also on criminal conspiracy alleged quantity of food grain was embezzled by the petitioner.

He has further stated that Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.7834 of 2023(13) dt.15-03-2024 the petitioner has defalcated Public Food Grain amount of Rs.
4,52,72,439.42/- and also the petitioner has not submitted the Stock Register and Inward Register till date.

7. Pursuant to the order of this Court, the court below has sent its report dated 03.01.2024 regarding status of the case in which he has stated that in this case, 09 witnesses have to be examined and will take almost twelve months time to conclude the trial as not witness has been examined yet.

8. Having heard rival contention of both the parties and considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case as also taking into account the report sent by the trial court, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.

9. Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioner, above named, is rejected with a direction to the court below to expedite the trial and conclude the same expeditiously preferably before December,
2024.
10. If the trial is not concluded within the aforesaid period i.e. before December, 2024, the petitioner will be at liberty to renew his prayer for bail before the court below Patna High Court CR.

MISC. 
No.7834 of 2023(13) dt.15-03-2024 which will be disposed of on its merit without being prejudiced by this order

. 
(Rudra Prakash Mishra, J) rishi/-
